profile.reading: Aligned Data Center DFW-03 sits at 3801 Britton Road in Mansfield, Texas, a newer addition to Aligned Dallas-Fort Worth footprint beyond its original Plano campus. Per the operator own February 2025 press release announcing the expansion, DFW-03 occupies a 27-acre site that includes an on-site electrical substation and was designed to support up to 350 kilowatts per rack, a very high density figure aimed at AI and high-performance-computing workloads, with initial availability targeted for the fourth quarter of 2025. The release did not disclose an overall megawatt or square footage figure for the building. Aligned also highlighted a community partnership tied to the project called the Roots for the Future Fund, developed with the City of Mansfield, though the release did not specify a dollar amount or program details beyond naming the partnership. Aligned, formerly known as Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history, most recently with an October 2025 agreement for a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, to acquire all of Aligned equity from majority owner Macquarie Asset Management and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with a close indicated around July 2026 in Aligned own materials though not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session. No specific tenant is named for DFW-03 in any source reviewed, and no overall capacity or square footage figure could be confirmed for the building as a whole. Mansfield sits within the broader Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex south of Arlington, an area that has attracted growing data-center investment as the original Dallas and Plano submarkets have filled in, a pattern also reflected in Aligned own DFW-04 expansion elsewhere in Plano around the same period.
profile.research_note: 27-acre site, on-site substation, 350 kW/rack support, and Q4 2025 initial availability target sourced to Aligned own Feb 2025 PR. Overall MW/sqft not disclosed in that release and deliberately not estimated.

reading.body:
Aligned Data Center DFW-03 is located in Mansfield, Texas, in Ellis County. The facility's IT load capacity is not published. Research into Aligned Data Centers, LLC suggests this campus is one of 51 North American campuses operated by the company, which reports 6.4 gigawatts of operational and planned capacity across all locations, but no building-specific megawatt figures for DFW-03 appear in available public sources.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 publish capacity figures totaling 468 megawatts. DFW-03 does not appear in the published capacity count, placing it outside the state's tracked fleet by megawatt. The company's operational footprint emphasizes Dallas as a market, and mentions a separate 540-megawatt project under development in Northwest Texas, but no capacity assignment to this specific Mansfield address is public.

Without published specifications, DFW-03 cannot be evaluated against the thesis that grid capacity constrains AI scaling. The facility's relevance to AI depends on future disclosure of its power allocation and load characteristics, which remain unreported.
